root_cause.text: In `bond_header_parse()`, when a stacked bonding configuration exists, the function uses `skb->dev` (which always points to the top-level device) to obtain the bonding private data, causing infinite recursion because the slave's `header_ops->parse()` calls `bond_header_parse()` again with the same top-level device instead of descending to the actual lower-layer device.
root_cause.evidence: The commit description states: "bond_header_parse() can loop if a stack of two bonding devices is setup, because skb->dev always points to the hierarchy top." The patch adds a `dev` parameter to `header_ops->parse()` and modifies `bond_header_parse()` to use the passed `dev` (from `slave->dev`) instead of `skb->dev`, ensuring recursion is bounded and the leaf parse method is called.
